description: This file defines the GroupedTabStructure class, which manages the structure of tabs in the SuiteCRM interface, including methods for retrieving and organizing tab data based on modules and configurations.

classes.name: GroupedTabStructure
classes.description: Class responsible for preparing and retrieving the tab structure in SuiteCRM, including handling module lists, patches, and iframe tabs.

methods.name: get_tab_structure
methods.description: Generates the complete tab-group structure based on provided module list, patches, and configuration flags.
